title: Installation Jobs: Company Reschedule Credits and the Failed-Access Fee
content:
**Ridgeline's own failures and the failed-access fee — Installation Jobs**

Ridgeline's own failures on an **Installation Jobs** record lower the failed-access fee charged for a visit on that job. The fee is multiplied by a credit share set by the company reschedule credits the job carries — credits of kind company reschedule credit recorded on the job:

| Company reschedule credits recorded on the job | Credit share |
|---|---|
| 2 or more | 0.5 |
| exactly one | 0.75 |
| none | one |

Late-arrival credits and fee waivers are other kinds of credit and do not count here. Credits recorded on another job of the customer do not count.

## Cases (hypothetical inputs, fee figure 280.00 before the credit share)

| Company reschedule credits on the job | Fee |
|---|---|
| 0 | 280.00 |
| 1 | 280.00 multiplied by 0.75, that is 210.00 |
| 2 | 280.00 multiplied by 0.5, that is 140.00 |
